text: {"name": "ble_tx_event_handle", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Processes a BLE TX event chain, writing a completion/status word into associated descriptor contexts until the expected event type bits are encountered.", "subsystem": "ble", "var_renames": {"v1": "tx_event_ctx", "v2": "tx_event_status", "v3": "tx_event", "v4": "tx_event_type"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 0, "meaning": "next TX event pointer"}, {"offset": 36, "meaning": "TX event type/flags field; bits 19-21 compared with 0x380000"}, {"offset": 76, "meaning": "pointer to associated TX event context/descriptor"}, {"offset": 28, "meaning": "TX event context active/count field; zero stops traversal"}, {"offset": 32, "meaning": "TX event context pointer whose word-minus-three status field is updated"}]}
